fields.title: Sandro Dias breaks two world records on the biggest skate ramp ever
fields.excerpt: Skateboarding history made: Sandro Dias drops in from a 22 storey building and shatters the high-speed ramp barrier.
fields.content: Brazilian skateboarding legend Sandro Dias etched his name into history by conquering the world's most daunting mega ramp, establishing new world records for vertical drop-in height and top speed on four wheels.

fields.title: What is Red Bull 64 Bars?
fields.excerpt: A quick and simple explanation to the concept of a unique global project that is challenging rap artists around the globe.
fields.content: Red Bull 64 Bars is an unadulterated freestyle cipher format: no chorus, no hooks, no distractions — just straight raw lyrical talent over hard-hitting production.

fields.title: Back with a bang: B-Girl Bar-B's road to Red Bull BC One World Final Tokyo
fields.excerpt: After two years of near misses, Bar-B stormed back to claim the Red Bull BC One Cypher India championship.
fields.content: With electrifying footwork and gravity-defying freezes, B-Girl Bar-B took the national breaking scene by storm on her way to representing on the global stage in Tokyo.

fields.title: Lyrics to '43 Ki Hawa' by Vijay DK x Karan Kanchan
fields.excerpt: Lyrics and exclusive track breakdown of the high-octane collaboration from season 3 of Red Bull 64 Bars India.
fields.content: A bar-for-bar breakdown of the cultural punchlines and street metaphors driving the explosive sonic explosion created by Vijay DK and Karan Kanchan.
